record.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the ‘Lushai Labour Corps’ during World War I and
    identify the correct one:
options: It consisted of 4500 young Mizo men, which constituted 3% of the total Mizo population.
The individual volunteers who went to France were granted an exemption from the ‘kuli’ (forced labour) for their entire lifetime.
The corps was divided into four companies and was entirely led by non-commissioned British officers and clerks.
Every volunteer was paid a flat remuneration of Rs. 15 regardless of whether they served inside or outside India.
